name: rnine-ui
description: Open-source design system libraries: @rnine/core (the shared core and the Plain look) and @rnine/nineos (NineOS), each a full component library with the same exports

scripts.build: yarn workspace @rnine/core build && yarn workspace @rnine/nineos build
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @rnine/core lint && yarn workspace @rnine/nineos lint
scripts.test: yarn workspace @rnine/core test && yarn workspace @rnine/nineos test
